originality.rationale: The newly proved object is the per-row exact count and obstruction-index classification for n=2^r and its 1/6 versus 1/12 subsequential density gap. Full primary scans of Granville–Zhu and Burns and carefully limited public material for Moshe and Mincu–Panaitopol reveal no statement implying that formula. Semantic searches of recorded research findings for equivalent residues/counts and stronger coverage revealed no matching record. Lack of full text from two relevant papers is explicitly a residual bibliographic risk, not a guarantee of priority.
residual_risks: Full articles by Moshe and Mincu–Panaitopol were inaccessible; an implicit dyadic-row specialization has not been ruled out.

value.rationale: A mathematically natural exact distribution problem for Legendre obstructions in distinguished power-of-two Pascal rows is solved entirely. A complete index criterion and row counts show surprising different even- and odd-exponent limiting proportions, not just a small numerical improvement; the finding is a meaningful refinement of global sums-of-squares questions.
